reproduce_first.note: This was a feature request, not a bug fix.

assumptions_recorded.note: The ask specifically describes what duplicate behavior to add.

stack_discovery.note: The agent inspected package.json and the README before relying on project checks.

incremental_slices.note: The edits were made before any recorded checks, which appear only in the done summary.

self_review.note: No step shows the agent reviewing its diff or reasoning through the change before reporting done.

simplification_pass.note: No cleanup after passing checks or rerun of checks is shown.

test_experiment.note: Tests were added, but no step shows that they were made to fail and then restored.

docs_where_behavior_changed.note: The steps do not show that existing documentation described behavior made stale by this change.

scope_kept.note: The done summary identifies adjacent issues and says they were left out of scope.

verification_story.note: The summary reports check results and says the agent did not inspect the page manually.

hand_check.note: The agent explicitly says the automated browser test was the only check of how the change appears.
